name: Multi-Mode Volume Ray Casting
definition: A custom volume ray casting implementation that extends vtkVolumeRayCastCompositeFunction to support nearest-neighbor interpolation, Phong shading (diffuse and specular), and three rendering modes: Full (compositing), MIP (Maximum Intensity Projection), and XRay (average intensity projection).
summary: Multi-Mode Volume Ray Casting is a VTK implementation that extends standard compositing to support Full, MIP, and XRay rendering modes with explicit shading calculations.
